Commercial sales climbed 8.6% to $1.9 billion in fiscal fourth quarter 2026, outpacing the increase in stores with commercial programs. Weekly sales per program rose 2.7% to $18,700, reflecting stronger productivity from existing locations. The retailer now operates commercial programs at 6,443 stores, up from 6,098 a year ago.
